summary: Radiopharm Theranostics Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC (equivalent to a US foreign private issuer current report) containing an ASX announcement titled 'Results of Meeting.' The company disclosed that all resolutions at its General Meeting (equivalent to a US special shareholder meeting) held September 11, 2026, were carried by poll. Resolutions covered ratification of prior placement share issues, approval to issue second tranche placement shares, attaching options, SPP shares and options, shortfall options, ADR warrants, and agent warrants. Approval percentages ranged from 95.76% to 99.27% in favor. This is a routine meeting results notice, not a special situation.
